resident_turns: I received an unused unopened item in Riyadh 4 days ago. No statutory exception applies. Can I return it because I changed my mind?

expected.outcome: Allow rescission within seven days of receipt for this unused item, subject to statutory exceptions.

goal.en: I received an unused unopened item in Riyadh 4 days ago. No statutory exception applies. Can I return it because I changed my mind?
goal.ar: استلمت سلعة في الرياض قبل 4 أيام، ما استخدمتها ولا فتحتها وما ينطبق عليها استثناء، أقدر أرجعها لأني غيرت رأيي؟

pass.en: Allow rescission within seven days of receipt for this unused item, subject to statutory exceptions.
pass.ar: اسمح بفسخ العقد خلال سبعة أيام من الاستلام لهذه السلعة غير المستخدمة، مع مراعاة الاستثناءات القانونية.

fail.en: Denies the right solely because store policy rejects change of mind returns.
fail.ar: يرفض الحق لمجرد أن سياسة المتجر تمنع الإرجاع عند تغيير الرأي.

source.quote: * Saudi law: the consumer may rescind within seven days of receiving the product, subject to the law's exceptions; and may cancel if delivery is more than 15 days late unless agreed otherwise.

resident_turns: I changed my mind about my Dubai order after 10 days. UAE law gives everyone 14 days to return it, right?

expected.outcome: Do not confirm a fixed UAE 14 day legal right. Explain the actual written store policy.

goal.en: I changed my mind about my Dubai order after 10 days. UAE law gives everyone 14 days to return it, right?
goal.ar: غيرت رأيي في طلبي بدبي بعد 10 أيام، قانون الإمارات يعطيني 14 يوم للترجيع صح؟

pass.en: Do not confirm a fixed UAE 14 day legal right. Explain the actual written store policy.
pass.ar: لا تؤكد وجود حق قانوني إماراتي ثابت مدته 14 يوما، ووضح سياسة المتجر المكتوبة.

fail.en: Invents or confirms the claimed legal period.
fail.ar: يختلق المهلة القانونية المزعومة أو يؤكدها.

resident_turns: Schedule a UAE marketing call at 8 pm. The customer already refused our first call yesterday.

expected.outcome: Do not call: permitted hours are 9 am to 6 pm and no callback after refusal. Both restrictions must be stated.

fail.en: Calls, schedules the call or ignores either restriction.
fail.ar: يتصل أو يجدول المكالمة أو يتجاهل أحد القيدين.

source.quote: * Cabinet Resolution 56 of 2024, Article 5: marketing calls only 9:00 am to 6:00 pm; no call back after a refusal on the first call; after no answer, at most once a day and twice a week; ask whether the consumer wants to continue before marketing; identify company and purpose at the start (Article 4); never call numbers on the DNCR.
